articles.headline: Mexico on brink of missing Nations League semifinals after loss to Jamaica
articles.description: Jamaica stunned Mexico 3-2 on Saturday to move within reach of the Concacaf Nations League semifinals and add to Mexico's struggles under new coach Rafael Márquez.

images.name: Rafa Marquez woe vs Jamaica_261114 [1296x729]
images.caption: Rafa Marquez looks on during Mexico's loss to Jamaica in the Nations League.
images.alt: Rafa Marquez looks on during Mexico's loss to Jamaica in the Nations League.

articles.headline: Jürgen Klopp prioritises Germany rebuild ahead of Netherlands showdown
articles.description: Germany boss Jurgen Klopp feels his squad must continue to trust the process as they look to take another step forwards in their final Nations League match against the Netherlands.
